title: Lint rules
summary: Every lint rule the engine ships, imported from rules --json
intro: Read this to see every lint rule drag-lint can check, with its category and whether it is on by default or fixable. You can filter the list by category or get it as JSON.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--standard cwe|cert|misra] [--rules-dir <dir>] - list every lint rule (catalog; each labelled rule shows its CWE/CERT/MISRA ids, --json adds `compliance`; --standard lists only rules labelled under it)
help: drag-lint rules [--json] [--category <name>] [--standard cwe|cert|misra] [--rules-dir <dir>]   - list every lint rule (catalog; each labelled rule shows its CWE/CERT/MISRA ids, --json adds `compliance`; --standard lists only rules labelled under it)
